from pathlib import Path
import re

source = Path('src/cache.lua').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
test = Path('tests/cache_spec.lua').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assignment = re.search(r'local\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*cache\s*\[\s*key\s*\]', source)
assert assignment, 'lookup must retain the selected entry'

guarded = re.search(rf'if\s+{entry}\s*==\s*nil\s+then\s*return\s+nil\s+end.*return\s+{entry}\.value', source, re.S)
short_circuit = re.search(rf'return\s+{entry}\s+and\s+{entry}\.value', source)
assert guarded or short_circuit, 'lookup must preserve present values and guard missing keys'
assert 'present' in test and 'kept' in test

# VPD byte contract

The four-byte header contains a little-endian payload length. Supported payloads are 8..256 bytes. Transport reads return the number of bytes received. The final byte is a checksum over the preceding payload bytes. A snapshot is visible only after complete validation.
